text:
emma: Heads-up — planning to push 'passage-3b-2026-01' into the model catalog and open a short canary tomorrow. Need quick gate-check: who can own staging deploy, smoke, and catalog pin?

raj: I can run the staging deploy and smoke tests. available 10:15–11:30 PT.

oliver: I can do the catalog pin+rollout (pin, canary policy, final promote). prefer to do pin after smoke passes.

sasha: I'll run a lightweight QA pass (prompt set + generation diff) and perf sanity. noticed a small latency bump in the local benchmarks yesterday — will surface numbers during smoke.

emma: Great. Proposed timeline (PT):
```
- 10:15: staging deploy (raj)
- 10:30: smoke run (raj + sasha) — smoke suite + perf quickcheck
- 10:45: pin + start 5% canary (oliver)
- 11:15: observe metrics, if green => 50% ramp; 11:45 promote final
- 12:00: finish
```

emma: Smoke checklist (short):
```
- health endpoints OK (/health, /ready)
- smoke prompts: 10 curated prompts (sanity of outputs)
- latency p95 within +15% of baseline
- no errors in logs (oom, kv cache misses)
- integration tests for routing/kv-cache pass
- record seed prompts & outputs to S3: s3://redwood-evals/passsage-3b/2026-03-17/
```

raj: For smoke I'll run this command and attach logs: 
```
./deploy-staging --model passage-3b-2026-01 --env staging --smoke
```

oliver: Pinning plan: create catalog entry with label `passage-3b:v1` -> add canary policy {percent:5, duration:30m} -> monitor console. If we need to rollback we un-pin and revert to `passage-3b:stable-2026-01`.

sasha: Quick note: my QA will include a few long-context prompts (2k tokens) — those tend to reveal KV cache regressions. If p95 latency climbs >20% we should abort.

emma: ops/monitoring request: can we get a temporary dashboard focusing on:
- RPS, p50/p95 latency for model route
- error rate (5xx)
- token cost delta
- deployment events stream
If someone from infra can add an ephemeral chart that'd be ideal.

raj: @deploy-bot can you schedule a staging job at 10:15 PT tomorrow and post the job link?

deploy-bot: Scheduled staging deploy for `passage-3b-2026-01` at 2026-03-17T10:15:00-07:00. Job: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/1845678901 (will post status updates).

oliver: I'll watch the canary and handle the catalog actions. will keep the rollback commit ready.

sasha: I'll share the QA checklist results in this thread and attach diff snippets.

emma: Perfect. If anything unexpected comes up, abort the canary and @emma @raj @oliver get paged. Otherwise we'll aim to finish by noon. :thumbsup:

raj: :thumbsup: saving smoke script output as `logs/pass-3b-smoke-1845678901.txt` and will post when done.

oliver: :eyes: will have the pin PR ready in the catalog repo for fast apply.

sasha: one last thing — anyone seen mismatch in tokenizer config between hf artifacts and our runtime? saw a warning locally — i'll include the log.

emma: thanks — bring any tokenizer mismatches up during staging; that could block promotion.
